Clerk Chervis is one of the cashiers handling customers at the Counting House in the Lower City.

Involvement

Chervis is too busy to talk to the party. If there is chaos and the civilians have fled, he tells the party the "good stuff" is downstairs. Before him  Gilla Merrun and  Brialavant are waiting in line to be serviced.

Idle banter

Chervis occassionally chats with  Clerk Zollerix, who manages the queue next to him:

  • Clerk Zollerix
    Are you thinking what I'm thinking?
  • Clerk Chervis
    I am, if you're looking where I'm looking.
  • Clerk Zollerix
    Do you have any blank vouching documents?
  • Clerk Chervis
    No - but I've got a little brandy in hip flask. Want a nip?
  • Clerk Zollerix
    During work hours? Are you crazy?
  • Clerk Chervis
    That's what they tell me. But we'll save it for later.
  • Clerk Zollerix
    So, I told him 'I'm not that kind of drow.'
  • Clerk Chervis
    You didn't! And what did he say?
  • Clerk Zollerix
    He said, and I'm not kidding, 'What's stopping you?'
  • Clerk Chervis
    Waukeen's scales! I'd have slapped him.
